system.description:
Usage held in 1 hand; Weight 2 lbs.

The sound of this small bronze handbell carries very little distance, yet corpses seem strangely peaceful after hearing it.

You gain a +2-status bonus to Perform Last Rites while using the bell as part of the rite.

You also gain the Final Toll ability:

Final Toll:

Activate 1 minute

Frequency 1/day

Target One corpse within 10 feet

The bell casts Last Rite upon the target without requiring PP. The spell otherwise functions normally.

If a disembodied spirit belonging to the deceased is willingly present when the bell is rung, it immediately understands that the rite has been performed upon its remains.

On the sheet: +2 status is pre-ticked on Perform Last Rites; Final Toll is Last Rite as an innate spell, 1/day, for no PP.

Pillars of Faith, Chapter 11.
